nip44_api.availability: EventSigner from applesauce-core; nip44 property is optional but populated for both NIP-07 and NIP-46 signers. Available in useDeviceSync as the 'signer' parameter.

similar_features.kind_30078_prior: No existing kind-30078 runtime code. Constant was removed in epic-task-snapshot-removal-crdt-convergence. sign_event:30078 absent from NIP46_PERMS at nostr.ts:25-26.

network_publish.signing: signer.signEvent(unsignedEvent) to get a signed NostrEvent first
network_publish.note: Already used for kind-5 and kind-10051 in client.tsx:388-424. From device-sync.ts context, client.network is available.

network_query.one_shot: client.network.request(relays, filters): Promise<NostrEvent[]> — used at device-sync.ts:604, 972, 1241

task_type.shape: { id: string, title: string, description: string, status: TaskStatus, assignee: string|null, createdBy: string, createdAt: number, updatedAt: number, updatedBy: string }
task_type.deleted_tasks: Deleted tasks are removed from TaskState map entirely — no tombstone field. Confirms D4.

is_group_joined_from_welcome.key: group.idStr (MLS hex, same as IDB key)
is_group_joined_from_welcome.set_by: markGroupJoinedFromWelcome(group.idStr) called inside joinFromWelcomeInvite at device-sync.ts:418

group_manager_invite_context.note: GroupManager does NOT import task-store or persistence. New publishTaskStateSync helper in device-sync.ts is the right insertion point.

two_identifier_scheme.group_id_str: group.idStr — MLS group ID as lowercase hex bytes. Used for: IDB keys (appendEvent, loadEvents, isGroupJoinedFromWelcome), NOT for relay event filters.
two_identifier_scheme.nostr_group_id_hex: getNostrGroupIdHex(group.state) — Nostr group ID used as #h tag on kind-445 relay events. Used for relay subscription filters.
two_identifier_scheme.implication: The d-tag for kind-30078 should use group.idStr (the MLS group ID), since both inviter and invitee derive the same idStr after the MLS group is established.

append_event.note: device-sync.ts already imports appendEvent directly from persistence.ts and calls it at device-sync.ts:876 inside applicationMessage handler.

task_store_load_path.hook_point: After 'if events.length === 0 AND isGroupJoinedFromWelcome(groupId)', call fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap before setLoading(false)

task_store_context.exposed: { tasks: Task[], dispatch: (event: TaskEvent) => Promise<void>, loading: boolean }
task_store_context.note: GroupManager does NOT use useTaskStore. task-store.tsx CAN call useMarmot() for signer/client/relays since it is mounted inside MarmotProvider.

device_sync_imports.signer_available: useDeviceSync receives signer: EventSigner parameter; client.signer is same object
device_sync_imports.new_helpers_fit_here: publishTaskStateSync and fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap are natural additions to device-sync.ts

nip46_perms_single_source.enforcement: nostr.test.ts:136-158 — greps all non-test source files for sign_event:N and nip44_* tokens; any file other than nostr.ts fails the test
nip46_perms_single_source.required_kinds_update: nostr.test.ts:101-107 — REQUIRED_KINDS array must include 30078 when adding sign_event:30078

existing_bootstrap_tests.task_sync_spec: e2e/tests/task-sync.spec.ts — TP-30: currently asserts B sees EMPTY board after join. Must be updated to assert B sees pre-join tasks.
existing_bootstrap_tests.snapshot_history_spec: e2e/tests/snapshot-history.spec.ts — TP-31/32: assert empty board. May need update or companion tests.

e2e_framework.e2e: Playwright 1.58, serial, workers=1, 180s timeout for multi-party tests
e2e_framework.relay: strfry ephemeral on port 7777, started by make e2e
e2e_framework.run: make e2e (NOT npx playwright test directly)

multi_party_pattern.contexts: browser.newContext() per actor; B auth before A
multi_party_pattern.pinClientSlot: pinClientSlot(page, bunkerUrl) mandatory for multi-context tests
multi_party_pattern.settle: settle(page, ms) for explicit wait between invite and join

ndk_subscriber.usage: openNdkSubscriber for relay-level assertions on raw events

testing_and_conventions.nip44_mocking: No existing NIP-44 unit-test utilities. For unit tests: vi.mock the signer with predictable encrypt/decrypt. For E2E: live bunker handles NIP-44.
